sourceText.he: הַכֹּל שׁוֹחֲטִין, וּלְעוֹלָם שׁוֹחֲטִין. הַכֹּל שׁוֹחֲטִין – הַכֹּל בִּשְׁחִיטָה, וַאֲפִילּוּ עוֹף.

positions.claim: 'All slaughter' means every creature is included in the requirement of slaughter, birds as well
positions.basis: reading the phrase as referring to what is slaughtered rather than to who slaughters
